decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a prolonged, accelerating E-axis decline starting ~550 and continuing through 664 without reversal; (2) a sharp E-axis drop and plateau from ~665 to 729, superposed on rising N and a transient U spike, with unclear recovery. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth trends without compelling opposing returns or ambiguous superpositions.

regions.observation: E-component shows a sustained, accelerating downward trend from ~index 550 onward, with no clear opposing return; the slope steepens around 600–630 and continues through 664. N and U remain noisy but lack comparable monotonic structure in this interval.

From ~665 to 729, E-component exhibits a sharp, multi-sample drop (~−10 to −28 MAD) followed by a plateau near −25 to −28, while N rises steadily and U shows a transient spike then recovery—suggesting a possible compound offset or platform with ambiguous return timing; the abruptness at ~665–670 warrants closer inspection.
